jtbd: diagnose and fix a defect without guessing
description: A repro-first debugging procedure with reliable reproduction, fail path tracing, hypothesis disproof, breadcrumb ledger, and completion gates.
trigger_contexts: unexpected behavior that needs root-cause diagnosis
procedure: Establish a reliable reproduction or stop and document what artifact or access is missing.
Trace the fail path end-to-end until expected behavior diverges from observed behavior.
Try to disprove the leading hypothesis with the smallest experiment before treating it as root cause.
Maintain a breadcrumb ledger of each run, what changed, what happened, and what it ruled in or out.
Implement the smallest fix that explains the failure.
forbidden_behaviors: speculative fix without reliable reproduction or explicit uncertainty
discarding breadcrumb evidence that contradicts the chosen hypothesis

bundled_resources.purpose: extend the compact skill procedure with the longer repro-first debugging workflow
bundled_resources.when: the failure is broad, the repro is unstable, or the operator needs the full debugging loop

bundled_resources.purpose: capture breadcrumb-style evidence and next actions across multiple debugging runs
bundled_resources.when: the investigation needs a durable trace or handoff packet

evaluation_prompts.prompt: A parser refactor introduced a failing regression test. Diagnose the root cause, make the smallest fix, and show the proof.
checks: traces the failing path before editing
connects the root cause to the final validation

evaluation_prompts.prompt: A CLI command fails intermittently in CI but not every local run. Use a repro-first debugging flow and avoid speculative rewrites.
checks: documents missing repro inputs if reproduction is not stable
keeps a breadcrumb ledger of experiments
avoids broad rewrites before root cause

success_criteria: original failure no longer reproduces under the reliable reproduction
root cause is connected to fix
breadcrumb ledger is consistent with the final root cause
failure_modes: test covers a mock instead of real behavior
